title: Objects have no scope tag where scope tags are in use

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'object carries', 'objects carry')} only the default scope tag

messages.businessImpact: The delegation model has gaps: these objects are visible to every administrator regardless of the boundaries the scope tags were created to enforce.
remediation: Apply the appropriate scope tag to each object, and remember the role assignment needs the same tag.
messages.cannotSee: Whether the default tag is wrong for an object is a judgement about how the tenant has divided its administration, which this cannot make: it reports that the object sits outside the division rather than that it should not. The tag is matched by identifier rather than by name, so a tenant that renamed its default tag is still read correctly, and an object whose tags this run could not read is passed over rather than reported as untagged.
